relations.statement: A 2n-leg perfect tensor is proportional to an isometry for every bipartition into k <= n inputs and 2n-k outputs (Def. 2).
Stabilizer generators of the CSS toric code commute pairwise.

lemmas.statement: HaPPY 2015 defines perfect tensors, builds the 6-qubit one from the [[5,1,3]] code, and places it on the {5,4} tiling to obtain an isometric bulk-to-boundary code (Thm. 1), with S_A = |gamma_A| log v for connected regions (Thm. 2) and a greedy-geodesic lower bound for general regions (Thm. 3).

near_misses.claim: The HaPPY code is a full model of AdS/CFT.
